raw_segments.text: Clarence, alas, for whose sake did I that ill deed?
For Edward, for my brother, for his sake.
He sends you not to murder me for this, for in that sin he is as deep as I if God will
Oh, know you yet he doth it publicly.
Take not the quarrel from his powerful arm.
He needs no indirect or lawless course to cut off those that have offended him.
